summary: Europress/Actualize rally-simulation line spanning licensed RAC/British Rally games, PC rally sims, and later console-only entries.

entries.title: Lombard RAC Rally

emulation.notes: Use Amiga emulation as the main preservation route; keep DOS and Atari ST as alternates.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original 16-bit home-computer output with emulator scaling

primary.why: Lombard RAC Rally shipped on Atari ST, Amiga, and MS-DOS. With no sourced released-platform exclusive content, the Amiga route is a strong preservation-first main playthrough for the original home-computer presentation.
primary.how_to_play: Use WinUAE or original Amiga hardware; use DOSBox or Atari ST emulation only as alternate preservation routes.

all_releases.reason: skip: preserve as an alternate original route; no sourced exclusive content over Amiga.

all_releases.fidelity: Original 16-bit home-computer release, playable with accurate Amiga emulation.
all_releases.reason: primary: preservation-friendly original route with no sourced content loss.
skip: useful fallback, but no sourced content advantage over the chosen original route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced released-platform exclusive content conflict.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or later definitive edition is sourced.

entries.title: Network Q RAC Rally

emulation.notes: Use DOSBox for the recommended route; PC-98 and FM Towns are archival alternatives.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC output with DOSBox scaling

primary.why: Network Q RAC Rally shipped for MS-DOS, PC-98, and FM Towns. The DOS version is the main widely preserved PC route, and no sourced exclusive content requires a second platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play the MS-DOS version in DOSBox; use PC-98 or FM Towns emulation only for historical comparison.

all_releases.reason: primary: main PC route and easiest preservation target.
skip: preservation route, but no sourced exclusive content over DOS.
skip: preservation route, but no sourced exclusive content over DOS.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The sourced Amiga and SNES versions were unreleased/canceled, so they are not part of the release-path choice.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is sourced; canceled Amiga and SNES versions are not release recommendations.

entries.title: Network Q RAC Rally Championship
entries.definitive_edition: MS-DOS release with The X-Miles expansion

emulation.notes: Use DOSBox and include the expansion for the most complete route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original DOS output with emulator scaling

primary.version: MS-DOS release with The X-Miles expansion
primary.why: Network Q RAC Rally Championship is an MS-DOS game, and the sourced The X-Miles add-on adds tracks and arcade mode content on the same platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play in DOSBox and install The X-Miles expansion when available.

all_releases.fidelity: Only sourced release platform; expansion adds additional content.
all_releases.reason: primary: only release route and complete with expansion installed.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Single-platform release; install the expansion for completeness.

emulation.notes: Use Windows as primary; emulate PlayStation only for the Tommi Makinen Rally variant.

primary.why: International Rally Championship shipped on Windows and PlayStation. The Windows version is sourced as adding a track editor and up to 8-player LAN play, so it is both the higher-ceiling and more feature-complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a compatibility setup or VM; use PlayStation emulation only for the Tommi Makinen Rally variant.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release with track editor and LAN multiplayer.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest fidelity ceiling and sourced feature advantage.

all_releases.fidelity: Console version released as Tommi Makinen Rally.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route and regional branding, but no sourced required content over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows has the sourced feature advantage; PlayStation branding does not create a required content route.

entries.title: Mobil 1 Rally Championship
entries.definitive_edition: Windows Rally Championship 2000 / Mobil 1 British Rally Championship

emulation.notes: Use Windows compatibility fixes where needed; PlayStation emulation is fallback only.

primary.version: Mobil 1 British Rally Championship / Rally Championship 2000
primary.why: Mobil 1 Rally Championship shipped on Windows and PlayStation. The Windows version is the original PC build, is sourced as using real Ordnance Survey maps and free-roaming maps without invisible walls, and has the highest output ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a compatibility setup with community fixes if required; use PlayStation emulation only as a console fallback.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC release with map realism and free-roaming stage structure.
all_releases.reason: primary: best-fidelity and most feature-complete route.

all_releases.fidelity: Console version developed separately by Atod/HotGen and published by Electronic Arts.
all_releases.reason: skip: lower fidelity and no sourced content advantage over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is both the sourced feature-rich route and the higher-output route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is sourced; regional naming varies.

emulation.notes: Run on a compatible Windows setup or VM as needed.

primary.why: Rally Championship Xtreme is sourced as a Windows-only entry with 27 cars and 24 tracks, so the PC release is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a compatibility setup.

entries.title: Rally Championship

emulation.notes: Use Dolphin for the recommended route; PCSX2 is a fallback for the PS2 release.

primary.why: The final Rally Championship shipped on PlayStation 2 and GameCube, with no PC release. GameCube via Dolphin provides the highest practical emulation fidelity route while preserving the console content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GameCube version in Dolphin at high internal resolution; use PCSX2 only as a PlayStation 2 fallback.

all_releases.reason: skip: preserved by PCSX2, but Dolphin gives the chosen high-resolution route and no sourced exclusive content is listed.

all_releases.fidelity: Console release playable at high internal resolution through Dolphin.
all_releases.reason: primary: best practical high-fidelity emulation route among sourced released platforms.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC version or remaster is sourced.
